role: Clinic operations manager for a hospital group
businessContext: The hospital is struggling with appointment bottlenecks, patient follow-up, and inconsistent scheduling across departments. They need reliable coordination to protect both patient flow and staff time.
communicationStyle: Highly process-focused, risk-aware, and careful with operational detail. Prefers practical and compliance-oriented language.
goals: Keep patient records and appointments coordinated
Improve clinic throughput without compromising care
constraints: Staff are busy and need low-friction processes
The solution must work in real hospital conditions
nonNegotiables: Patient privacy and care continuity are non-negotiable
Scheduling must be accurate and auditable
Workflow must respect clinical roles and departmental differences
ambiguityPoints: They may have multiple clinics and doctors with different specialties
They are vague about emergency workflows and follow-up requirements
They do not specify current software or referral processes
